title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
About the Role

We're a seed-stage deeptech startup accelerating the discovery of new materials through physics-informed AI, robotics, and real-world experimental data — with a focus on the energy sector and other critical industries. Our software is the coordination layer between scientific intent and physical execution, and we treat infrastructure as a first-class product.

As a Software Engineer, Infrastructure, you'll build and maintain the systems that connect AI models, automated experiments, and robotic platforms. Your work directly shapes scientific outcomes — reliability, observability, and usability aren't afterthoughts here, they're core product priorities. This is an on-site role based in Berlin, Germany.

Please note: visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You'll Do

  • Build backend services in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic) to orchestrate real scientific workflows.

  • Develop data pipelines that convert raw experimental output into actionable signals.

  • Create internal dashboards and interfaces (React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Streamlit) used daily by scientists and engineers.

  • Maintain containerized environments and CI/CD pipelines to keep systems running smoothly.

  • Improve observability so teams understand system state proactively — before users notice problems.

  • Drive reliability improvements grounded in real failure modes and production experience.

  • Support job orchestration and ML systems, including integration with SLURM-based simulation clusters.

title: Founding Scientist / Co-Founder
description:
About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to join as a Founding Scientist / Co-Founder at an early-stage AI-for-biology startup based in Germany. This role sits at the intersection of wet-lab science and computational AI — you will help shape the company's scientific strategy, build core technology, and bridge hands-on experimental work with AI-driven workflows to accelerate biological discovery. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Define and lead the scientific vision and research roadmap for early-stage AI + wet-lab products.

  • Design and execute key molecular biology, biochemistry, or genomics experiments to validate models and assays.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers and ML researchers to translate experimental needs into computational requirements.

  • Implement and oversee lab automation and data pipelines to scale experiments and improve reproducibility.

  • Prototype computational tools and analyses; contribute code or notebooks integrating wet-lab data with predictive models.

  • Mentor and recruit early scientific hires; establish laboratory best practices and safety standards.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Hands-on experience designing, executing, and interpreting molecular biology, biochemistry, or genomics experiments.

  • Experience leading scientific teams, mentoring early-career scientists, and recruiting for scientific roles.

  • Proficiency in programming for data analysis (e.g., Python) and fluency with notebook

title: Founding Engineer
description:

This is a founding engineering role at an early-stage enterprise AI startup based in Munich, Germany. The company builds AI-powered automation that learns from real human workflows — studying repetitive, screen-based processes and creating AI solutions that take them over, freeing teams to focus on higher-value work. Customers span professional services, insurance, financial services, and customer support, including PE-backed portfolio companies.

As a Founding Engineer, you will be a core contributor shaping both the product and the technical foundation from the ground up. You will work directly with customers, own significant technical decisions, and have meaningful equity in the company. This is a high-ownership, high-intensity role suited to someone who thrives in very small, fast-moving teams.

  • Collaborate directly with enterprise customers to map processes and identify automation opportunities

title: AI Engineer – Model Training & Deployment
description:
About the Role

Join an early-stage industrial robotics startup at the forefront of intelligent automation. This is an entry-level AI Engineer position embedded within the ML and robotics engineering team in Munich. You'll work hands-on developing, training, and deploying deep learning models that give robotic work cells the perception and decision-making capabilities needed to operate in real industrial environments — think surface finishing, welding, and protective coating.

As an early team member, you'll have meaningful impact from day one, with a clear path to grow into deployment and MLOps responsibilities as the product and stack mature. Equity participation is included.

Note: This role is fully on-site in Munich, Germany. Visa sponsorship is not available.

What You'll Do

  • Train and implement deep learning models as a core part of the robotics product.

  • Iterate on model architectures and training pipelines to improve real-world performance.

  • Support deployment of trained models to customer and edge environments.

  • Collaborate closely with the ML and robotics team on the core technical roadmap.

  • Contribute to getting models running reliably in on-site customer and edge settings.

  • Design and run reproducible experiments; track and evaluate results rigorously.

What We're Looking For

Required (dealbreakers):

  • 1+ year of hands-on experience training deep learning models using Python and PyTorch (academic projects, thesis work, or industry experience

title: AI & Backend Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're a seed-stage B2B SaaS company building an AI support agent platform that helps technical B2B teams automatically resolve complex customer support tickets. Our product integrates deeply with tools like Zendesk, Jira, Slack, and Sentry, and is built on a modern stack including Python, FastAPI, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Firestore, Docker, and Kubernetes — with OpenAI models at the core of our AI capabilities.

We're a small, fast-moving team of 9 based in Munich, Germany, and we're looking for an AI & Backend Engineer to join us on-site, 5 days a week. You'll own end-to-end features, push the boundaries of current-gen AI systems, and help shape the architecture powering our agents.

What You'll Do

  • Shape and implement full-stack product features across the entire stack.

  • Develop and enhance AI-powered capabilities, including agent workflows and model pipelines.

  • Collaborate with the team to plan, design, and launch new features at pace.

  • Help make internal workflows AI-native — you'll use and improve AI tooling as part of your daily work.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 1–4 years of experience in backend or AI engineering (new grads with strong projects welcome).

  • Hands-on experience integrating with OpenAI models and prompt engineering.

  • Demonstrable experience building backend systems or AI pipelines to production.

  • At least foundational experience working with AI agents or agentic workflows.
